# Upgrayedd 0.2.5 (7)
Upgrayedd is now a native-only dashboard, with a clearer Overview and a separate Detailed Stats page.
- See the recommendation, your current Mac, and three optional replacement configurations together, including specifications, prices, benefits, tradeoffs, and Apple links. - Explore active-use history, application activity, live readings, and the complete evidence scorecard in Detailed Stats. - Read charts with accurate time spacing, explicit gaps, and selectable history ranges. Expand the daily summary to see every observed day. - Keep one responsive desktop instance while the independently managed background collector continues recording. - Retire the localhost web dashboard; the updated collector no longer starts its web server.
Existing telemetry, reports, and preferences remain on this Mac. Update checks send no Upgrayedd telemetry or hardware profile; the feed host receives ordinary HTTP metadata. Apple configuration links open only when selected. Prices are reference configurations, not guarantees of checkout pricing or measured performance gains.
Requires macOS 14 or later. Universal binary for Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
Existing installations: choose Upgrayedd > Check for Updates… and approve installation and relaunch. For a first installation, open the DMG and move Upgrayedd.app to /Applications.
SHA-256: `87c64e5970de10d3438c38023f271a96c6f14b6e8548e3c9708cda098dcdcc0a`

# Upgrayedd 0.2.2 (4)
This release fixes a macOS SwiftUI layout loop that could leave the visible dashboard consuming a full CPU core. The dashboard now uses a predictable non-lazy layout and remains responsive with existing long-running telemetry histories.
It also includes the corrected background collector path from 0.2.1: the LaunchAgent runs the signed executable inside the installed application bundle so Sparkle remains available.
Upgrayedd keeps telemetry on this Mac. Update checks send no Upgrayedd telemetry or hardware profile; the feed host receives ordinary HTTP metadata. Downloads, installation, and restarts always require confirmation.
Requires macOS 14 or later. Universal binary for Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
SHA-256: `56987be1d66c375f1605cd882732c3cf93ffecaff487da3fdbc2f8e8d69063c9`
